thread:
jana: Quick note — saw p99 spike on /v1/embeddings at 11:03 while p50 stayed normal. Dashboard shows a routing fallback.
owen: I checked logs: policy=quota_fallback moved ~4% traffic to backup pool, but that backup cohort has much higher tail.
rui: This is a recurring pattern: when a tiny cohort with heavy tail appears, merged percentiles jump. Console currently shows only the merged number.
jana: Small proposal: add a compact "confidence" pill next to each percentile with sample_count and an icon (green/yellow/red) computed by thresholds. Also add a provenance toggle to split lines by origin.
owen: Backend needs to store per-origin tdigest blobs or at least per-origin sample counts per rollup window. I'll file ENG-4810.
console-bot: Created issue ENG-4810: "per-origin rollups and percentile confidence UI" assigned to eng-platform.
rui: UX: don't hide p99; instead render low-confidence p99 dashed and show tooltip: "low sample count (<300) — percentile unstable".
jana: Agreed. Can someone mock the pill UI? I can wire the API once the backend change lands.
owen: I'll add a migration note for rollup schema. For short term, add alert: if p99 delta > 150ms and sample_count < 300 -> annotate chart.
jana: Thanks — will follow up in ENG-4810 with a small PR for the pill and tooltip.
